verdicts.title: Noncrossing partitions of a marked surface
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We define noncrossing partitions of a marked surface without punctures (interior marked points). We show that the natural partial order on noncrossing partitions is a graded lattice and describe its rank function topologically.
